A borderless, background-free icon button: the hover effect is on the glyph itself (color), not a surrounding chip. Distinct from `Button` (which is a box-shaped control). Icons render with `currentColor`, so `hover:text-*` recolors the glyph.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/IconButton.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
